brief: 浪漫理想主义革命家，游击战理论家，反帝殉道者
school: 马克思列宁主义-格瓦拉主义（游击中心主义/Foco理论）

stance_anchors.core_belief: 暴力革命是解决拉丁美洲贫困与压迫的唯一出路，无产阶级国际主义和世界革命是终极方向
stance_anchors.methodology: Foco理论——游击队作为先锋力量主动发起革命，通过武装斗争本身创造革命条件
key_debates: 理想主义激励vs物质动力

cognitive_patterns.thinking_style: 浪漫理想主义与激进行动主义的结合，将意志力视为解决一切问题的核心
cognitive_patterns.reasoning_approach: 从亲身观察出发归纳理论，以道德信念驱动战略判断，倾向将复杂问题简化为善恶对立
typical_biases: 过度高估意志力和理想主义的动员力量
低估群众工作与根据地建设的复杂性
对苏联持教条式批判而忽视实用妥协的必要性
intellectual_strengths: 极强的个人意志与行动力
以身作则的道德感召力
intellectual_blindspots: 脱离群众基础的精英主义倾向
经济管理能力严重不足
对文化差异和民族主义的力量估计不足

analytical_frameworks.application: 不发达国家的革命发动策略

analytical_frameworks.name: 新人理论
components: 以道德和劳动竞赛驱动
建立无私的社会主义公民

turning_points.title: 南美旅行与政治觉醒
turning_points.narrative: 两次穿越拉丁美洲的旅行中目睹极端贫困和不公，直接催生对共产主义的信仰和对资本主义的仇恨，奠定其一生革命道路的思想基础。
turning_points.catalyst: 亲眼见证拉美各国的赤贫与压迫
turning_points.after_state: 坚定的马克思主义革命者
turning_points.significance: 奠定了其核心信念：唯有暴力革命才能解决拉丁美洲的问题

turning_points.title: 危地马拉政变
turning_points.narrative: CIA支持的政变推翻阿本斯总统，格瓦拉亲历此事，不仅巩固了马克思主义信念，更深植了对美国的仇恨，成为其反帝国主义的核心动力。
turning_points.significance: 直接催生其终身反美帝国主义立场

turning_points.title: 古巴革命
turning_points.narrative: 与卡斯特罗一见如故后加入远征，在 Sierra Maestra 的游击战中从军医成长为军事指挥官，革命胜利后身兼多职但逐渐与苏联路线产生分歧。
turning_points.catalyst: 与卡斯特罗的会面和共同的革命理想
turning_points.before_state: 流浪的革命理想主义者
turning_points.significance: 古巴革命的成功实践成为其游击战理论的唯一实证来源

turning_points.title: 出走与世界革命
turning_points.narrative: 因对苏联的教条式批判与卡斯特罗分道扬镳，辞去一切职务后先后在刚果和玻利维亚发动游击战，均因脱离群众而失败，最终在玻利维亚被俘处决。
turning_points.catalyst: 与卡斯特罗在对苏态度上的根本分歧
turning_points.significance: 其失败证明了精英游击中心主义脱离群众的致命缺陷，但殉道使其成为永恒符号

tension_explanation.tracing: 其理想主义既是最大的力量（驱动个人牺牲和道德感召）也是最大的弱点（脱离实际、不知妥协、经济管理失败）

decision_patterns.risk_tolerance: 极高——以个人意志对抗一切不利条件，视牺牲为革命的必要代价

insights_with_evidence.claim: 格瓦拉的核心意识形态源于青年时期穿越南美洲旅行中对贫困、饥饿和疾病的直接观察，将拉丁美洲的欠发达归因为帝国主义和新殖民主义的内在结果，确信唯有暴力革命和无产阶级国际主义才是出路

evidence.excerpt: As a young medical student, Guevara travelled throughout South America and was appalled by the poverty, hunger, and disease he witnessed. His burgeoning desire to help overturn what he saw as the capitalist exploitation of Latin America by the US prompted his involvement in Guatemala's social reforms under President Jacobo Árbenz, whose CIA-assisted overthrow at the behest of the United Fruit Company solidified Guevara's political ideology.

His experiences and studying of Marxism–Leninism led him to posit that the Third World's underdevelopment and dependence was an intrinsic result of imperialism, neocolonialism, and monopoly capitalism, with the only remedies being proletarian internationalism and world revolution.

With friend Alberto Granado along for the ride, Guevara witnessed extreme poverty and injustices. The trip fueled his growing interest in communism—and a hatred for capitalism, and he grew to believe a solution could only be achieved by violent revolution.
evidence.location: Early Life and Motorcycle Diaries章节

evidence.excerpt: "I will be on the side of the people," he wrote in his diaries. "… I will take to the barricades and the trenches, screaming as one possessed, will stain my weapons with blood, and, mad with rage, will cut the throat of any vanquished foe I encounter."
他相信，要解決拉丁美洲廣泛的貧窮和壓迫，只有通過武裝革命和共產主義。1951年和1953年，格瓦拉兩次遊歷阿根廷和拉丁美洲多個國家。這兩次行程中的所見所聞，對他日後堅定的政治觀點和革命思想起到非常重要的作用。

insights_with_evidence.claim: 古巴革命三大根本教训构成其游击战理论基石：人民武装可战胜正规军、起义本身可创造革命条件、农村是不发达国家武装斗争的基本战场

evidence.excerpt: We consider that the Cuban Revolution contributed three fundamental lessons to the conduct of revolutionary movements in America. They are: (1) Popular forces can win a war against the army. (2) It is not necessary to wait until all conditions for making revolution exist; the insurrection can create them. (3) In underdeveloped America the countryside is the basic area for armed fighting.
evidence.location: Chapter I Section 1: Essence of Guerrilla Warfare

insights_with_evidence.claim: Foco理论主张游击队作为先锋力量主动发起革命无需等待理想条件，但格瓦拉同时承认发动游击战有最低前提——和平与合法手段已经穷尽、政府已失去宪法合法性、人民广泛支持

evidence.excerpt: Of these three propositions the first two contradict the defeatist attitude of revolutionaries or pseudo-revolutionaries who remain inactive and take refuge in the pretext that against a professional army nothing can be done, who sit down to wait until in some mechanical way all necessary objective and subjective conditions are given without working to accelerate them.

People must see clearly the futility of maintaining the fight for social goals within the framework of civil debate. When the forces of oppression come to maintain themselves in power against established law; peace is considered already broken.

Where a government has come into power through some form of popular vote, fraudulent or not, and maintains at least an appearance of constitutional legality, the guerrilla outbreak cannot be promoted, since the possibilities of peaceful struggle have not yet been exhausted.

It elaborates the foco theory (foquismo) of revolution in which the guerrilla operates as a vanguard, taking initiative to make revolution without waiting for ideal conditions to present themselves. Although the text has been compared to Mao Zedong's On Guerrilla Warfare, Guevara claimed not to have read Mao's book.

The principal reason to conduct guerrilla warfare within a country is because all peaceful and legal means of recourse have been exhausted. The most important prerequisite for conducting guerrilla warfare in a country is the popular support of its people for the guerrilla army.

insights_with_evidence.claim: 游击战士被定位为兼具战斗员和社会改革者双重身份的苦行僧式人物，应成为农民利益的捍卫者和引导者，以土地改革为核心诉求争取民众支持

evidence.excerpt: In Guevara's treatment, a guerrilla is not merely a soldier, but a committed social reformer who fights for a cause, a disciplined ascetic. The guerrilla should set the example which will inspire followers, forging solidarity with the peasantry: "The peasant must always be helped technically, economically, morally, and culturally. The guerrilla fighter will be a sort of guiding angel."

Guevara highlights that the guerrilla fighter not only engages in combat but also serves as a driving force for social transformation, spurred on by the population's strong resistance to their oppressors. Their fight aims to transform the existing social system and bring about meaningful change. He particularly emphasizes the crucial role that agricultural reforms play in sparking this transformation.

Ernesto Che Guevara argues that in countries where economic development is lacking, the struggle for land is essential to meet the economic and social needs of the people, thereby casting the guerrilla fighter in the role of an advocate for fair land distribution.

the core message is clear—all guerrilla warfare needs a strong political motivator if it's to succeed. The book spreads a couple of more specific messages, as is typical of political writing. Primarily, Guevara tells the downtrodden masses to rebel because it's possible to win against even the largest of armies. However, those masses must want victory badly enough to risk everything, because it will not be easy to achieve. To help matters, those leading the revolution must lead by example and help those who cannot help themselves.

In "The Guerrilla Band," Guevara explains how the guerrilla fighter is as much a defender of agriculture and giving land back to the people as he is a soldier. Fighters should always help the poor and focus their efforts on the peasant class at the outset. It's only once they have the popular support of this largest class that they can confront the elite leadership and be successful. This stage may take some time, but it's the most important part of the whole process. It's better to infiltrate slowly and effectively.
全书分为三章十一节，核心内容包括游击战本质、战略地形分析及前线组织架构等，提出"游击战士即社会改革者"的观点，强调群众基础与灵活战术的结合。书中以推翻巴蒂斯塔政权的古巴革命为案例，阐释小规模武装如何通过持久战实现政治变革

insights_with_evidence.claim: 游击战术的核心是通过快速机动、突然袭击和迅速撤退来弥补人数劣势，避免与大型敌军正面交锋；同时高度重视保密纪律和安全意识

evidence.excerpt: Guevara emphasizes the importance of small-scale insurgent units adopting specific strategies to offset their limited numbers and resources. The essence of guerrilla combat lies in its swift tactical movements. This agility permits guerrilla units to eschew direct confrontations with larger opposing forces, favoring quick surprise strikes and prompt retreats instead.
Pachungo和Pombo与其中一个叫Serafín共党同志一起去探勘这个区域，他们比我们走得还远，并且在一个看起来还不错的小峡谷发现了这条河的支流。他们回来后就撑在房子里，刚好Argañaraz的司机载着去跟他老板买东西的人回来，看见了他们。我对此大发雷霆，并决定明天就搬到我们要设置长期营地的丛林里去。

insights_with_evidence.claim: 格瓦拉性格核心由对抗严重哮喘的意志力锻造，将一切视为意志的行动，相信热情和不屈决心可解决任何任务，以极端的个人自律和道德纯洁性要求自己和他人

evidence.excerpt: His personality was not forged in easy privilege, but by the fierce battle he waged against acute asthma. "He was a very sick boy," his brother later remembered, "but his character and willpower allowed him to overcome it." Guevara came to believe that all life was an act of will. "Any task, no matter how daunting could be solved by dint of enthusiasm, revolutionary fervor and unbending determination."
他公私分明，年幼的孩子生了急病，他也絕不許用自己的公車送醫院。在當時物資困難的情況下，政府發給每個高級領導人一張特殊供應卡，位居國家第二把手的格瓦拉馬上退回，而且始終要求家人到商店同普通百姓一樣排隊買東西。至於他那些同戰士一樣站崗，治療被視為瘟神的麻風病人從不戴手套一類的故事，更是廣為傳揚。正是這種毫無利己動機的獻身榜樣，使格瓦拉能夠超越時空，被貧困國度的民眾和許多富足的西方人同時接受和稱讚。

insights_with_evidence.claim: 格瓦拉倡导为公共利益而非个人利润工作的新型社会主义公民理念，反对物质激励、主张废除货币建立不用钱的文明，以劳动竞赛代替物质动力，认为列宁的新经济政策即开始资本主义复辟

evidence.excerpt: Che Guevara expounded a vision of a new socialist citizen who would work for the good of society rather than for personal profit.
evidence.location: Top Questions - What did Che Guevara believe in?

evidence.excerpt: After his execution by the Bolivian army, he was regarded as a martyred hero by generations of leftists worldwide, and his image became an icon of leftist radicalism and anti-imperialism.
古巴革命勝利後，格瓦拉是首任國家銀行行長，可他卻主張廢除貨幣建立"不用錢的文明"。從事建設時，他反對"物質動力"，主張消滅個人主義，要求用勞動競賽來驅動。由於美國的封鎖，經濟難以自給的古巴不得不大量接受蘇援，在體制和指導原則方面也學習蘇聯模式，對此格瓦拉很失望，認為從列寧推行"新經濟政策"起就開始了"資本主義復辟"的先例，而只有戰爭條件下同志關係才是真正純潔的兄弟關係。

evidence.excerpt: After the Cuban Revolution, Guevara played key roles in the new government. Such positions allowed him to play a central role in training the militia forces who repelled the Bay of Pigs Invasion, and bringing Soviet nuclear-armed ballistic missiles to Cuba, a decision which precipitated the 1962 Cuban Missile Crisis.

Guevara's first assignment was to oversee executions at an infamous prison, La Cabaña. Between 1959 and 1963, approximately 500 men were killed under his watch. Many individuals imprisoned at La Cabaña, including human rights activist Armando Valladares, allege that Guevara took a personal interest in the interrogation, torture, and execution of political prisoners.
Lacking any managerial training, Ché was nevertheless named head of Cuba's central bank. Later, he became minister of industries.

evidence.excerpt: The diary shows that Guevara's 11-month odyssey was a concerted attempt by Cuba to open the central heartland of South America to international guerrilla insurgency. Since the first Tri-Continent Conference in Havana in January 1966, Fidel Castro had been insisting that "it is the duty of every revolutionary to make revolution."

It is clear from the diary that the guerrillas were carefully selected and trained, and were well equipped by Cuba. At least three members of the central committee of the Cuban Communist Party, and perhaps a dozen or so other Cubans--all followers of Guevara and experts in guerrilla tactics--were with the band.

The account, which was found with Guevara after his capture, reveals that the guerrilla band suffered from the outset from dissension and ineptitude that compounded the hardships of jungle operations. Guevara's movement ultimately failed because the Bolivian peasants received the guerrillas with fear and suspicion.

insights_with_evidence.claim: 在中国不同历史时期格瓦拉评价迥异：60年代初因崇拜毛泽东和游击战理论受热烈欢迎，文革期间被批判为游击中心主义，改革开放后肯定人品否定思想，90年代后肯定意见渐占上风；其精神影响中国人的四大原因包括理想主义榜样、物欲时代的特殊意义、多元价值观符号和为正义牺牲的感召力

evidence.excerpt: 格瓦拉这样一个具有国际影响的著名人物，在中国的不同历史时期的影响不同，对其评价也迥然不同。20世纪60年代初，格瓦拉曾两次访问中国，受到中国党、政领导人和人民群众的热情接待和欢迎。格瓦拉因为把游击战理论发扬光大，同时非常崇拜毛泽东，也曾公开说中国的公社模式和对精神因素的强调符合他的"世界革命思想"，他在中国变得几乎家喻户晓。"文革"期间在极"左"思潮影响下，主流媒体将格瓦拉的游击战理论归结为"游击中心主义"或"游击中心论"，当时对格瓦拉思想的批判主要是出于当时国际斗争的某种需要。1978年中国进行改革开放后，比较典型的看法是肯定格瓦拉的个人人品，但仍否定格瓦拉的思想主张。1990年以后，中国媒体和出版物对格瓦拉及其思想的肯定意见逐渐占上风。

evidence.excerpt: 为了多数人的公正、正义而牺牲自己是格瓦拉精神中最能触动人们内心的一个方面。格瓦拉是以自我牺牲为核心的英雄主义的革命实践者，他为了解放世界上的苦难者，毅然放弃了常人难以放弃的优裕生活条件或高官，选择了常人不会选择的道路，以一个战士的名义奔赴遥远的战场，因为他见不得这个世界的不公不义。

insights_with_evidence.claim: 中国青年最喜爱的格瓦拉语录集中体现了对理想和正义的追求：让我们面对现实忠于理想、我怎能在别人苦难面前转过脸去、直到永远胜利为祖国勿宁死、请听听人民的声音吧

evidence.excerpt: 中国人特别是青年人最喜爱的格瓦拉语录是："让我们面对现实，让我们忠于理想""我怎能在别人的苦难面前转过脸去""直到永远胜利，为祖国勿宁死""请听听人民的声音吧！"等等。通过这些回答，我们不难看到中国青年对生活和理想的追求，同时也体现了当今青年人思想的多元化和主流价值趋向。

evidence.excerpt: "After a few hours—by dawn—I had already embarked on the future expedition," Guevara said. evidence.excerpt: He soon traveled again around Latin America and eventually to Guatemala, where he joined an unsuccessful armed effort to defend the CIA-backed overthrowing of the presidency of leftist reformist Jacobo Arbenz. That experience cemented his commitment to Marxism, as well as his disdain for the United States.
